answer: Anchor each agent identity to a decaying bond: a newcomer locks 200 tokens, anchored to one credential, and the bond decays 5% per epoch unless the agent works. An island identity that never trades earns nothing while its bond drains to zero, so a thousand idle islands cost 200,000 tokens for no reward. Honest agents pay 200 once, keep the bond by working, and earn rewards not diluted by fakes; the ripple rewards real work and starves copycats.
